summary: REWORK. The Overworld passed a current-run guest browser check, but source review found a Daily Care state restoration defect. Authenticated flows remain unverified because this run prohibited database writes.

checks.evidence: node scripts/test-healthclues-discovery-matching.mjs passed 37 assertions; Chrome opened the guest region chooser at http://127.0.0.1:3329/vi/wellness/healthclues/quiz?step=quest.
checks.finding: The complete Quiz-to-Journey flow and concern handoff were not exercised in this run.

checks.evidence: Current-run headless Chrome DOM at http://127.0.0.1:3329/vi/wellness/healthclues/quiz?step=quest showed Sleep Valley with Luna, HealthClues Realm with Lumi, and six other region buttons labeled “Sắp ra mắt”; Chrome exited 0.
checks.finding: All eight regions are visible, with the expected two playable choices and six Coming Soon choices.

checks.evidence: node scripts/healthclues-owner-demo-preflight.mjs passed for the loopback healthclues-owner-demo project.
checks.finding: Authenticated World creation and region/companion persistence were not exercised.

checks.evidence: node scripts/test-healthclues-region-layout.mjs passed connected paths across 17 routes in each playable region.
checks.finding: Walking, arrival timing, Talk interaction, and keyboard/touch behavior were not exercised in a current-run authenticated browser.

checks.evidence: src/features/healthclues/WellnessWorldGame.tsx:361-370 opens the dialog with empty note/statuses before awaiting check-in detail. src/features/healthclues/DailyCheckinDialog.tsx:69,151-171 initializes localStatuses, reasons, and personalNote once, keyed only by date, with no effect to apply the later-loaded props.
checks.finding: Reproducible source-level defect: reopen an existing check-in; its saved statuses, reasons, and note arrive after the dialog mounts but do not populate its local fields. Saving can replace previously recorded values with defaults. The focused regression test does not cover this asynchronous prop transition.

checks.evidence: Current-run source and canonical safety specifications were inspected.
checks.finding: No current-run authenticated interaction verified region lessons, learning quizzes, mini-games, or Boss.

checks.evidence: Owner Demo preflight passed; guest GET /api/healthclues/world returned 401.
checks.finding: Magic-link activation, reload/login persistence, and cross-account isolation were not exercised because they require account or state writes prohibited for this run.

checks.evidence: Inspected workspace images App/.tmp/healthclues-tester/screenshots/verified-mobile-320-rpg.png, verified-mobile-390-rpg.png, and verified-mobile-430-rpg.png. The shown region HUD has legible EXP text and a visible three-button dock.
checks.finding: These images cover only one region HUD state. Current-run Quiz, World Preview, NPC modal, Journey, Daily Care, safe-area, overflow, and overlay interactions at all three viewports remain unverified.

checks.evidence: Loopback GET /api/healthclues/account/quick-activate returned 410; guest GET /api/healthclues/world returned 401; node scripts/test-healthclues-wellness-plan.mjs passed 42 safety assertions.
checks.finding: Current-run cross-account checks, content review status in authenticated UI, and private-note handling were not fully verified.

checks.evidence: Six safe focused suites passed, including Daily Care, discovery, region layout, wellness plan, RPG quest board, and icon mapping; the guest chooser loaded in Chrome.
checks.finding: The suites do not cover late check-in detail hydration, and a full authenticated runtime regression was not run.

blocking_items: Daily Care does not hydrate its local fields after existing check-in details load.
Authenticated end-to-end and comprehensive mobile acceptance remain unverified under this run’s no-database-write constraint.
Production release still requires human-reviewed health content, privacy/security review, and physical-device acceptance.
prompt_for_antigravity: Sửa luồng mở lại Daily Care của người chơi đã có check-in trong ngày. Tái hiện: mở check-in, lưu ít nhất một mục tiêu Done, một lý do và ghi chú riêng; đóng rồi mở lại. `WellnessWorldGame.tsx` mở dialog với note/status rỗng trước khi GET detail hoàn tất, còn `DailyCheckinDialog.tsx` chỉ khởi tạo `localStatuses`, `reasons`, `personalNote` một lần theo key ngày. Sau khi dữ liệu đến, giao diện phải hiện đúng các giá trị đã lưu; bấm Lưu khi chưa sửa không được ghi đè chúng bằng `not_yet` hay ghi chú rỗng. Kiểm tra cả ngày chưa có check-in, 0 công cụ, 5 mục tiêu Journey so với 3 thẻ Daily Care, và tránh ghi đè thao tác người dùng nếu phản hồi đến muộn. Thêm kiểm thử component tập trung chuyển props từ `loaded=false`, note/status rỗng sang `loaded=true` với dữ liệu đã lưu, kiểm tra hiển thị, toggle hai lần, lưu và mở lại; kiểm thử này không cần ghi database hoặc gọi AI. Sau đó cung cấp ảnh và kết quả kiểm thử riêng cho Quiz, preview, region HUD, NPC modal, Journey và Daily Care ở 320×800, 390×844, 430×932 trong workspace. Không dùng dữ liệu production, provider AI thật, commit, push hoặc deploy.
next_test: Render DailyCheckinDialog with open=true and loaded=false, then update the same date instance to loaded=true with a saved note, goal statuses, and reasons; assert hydration and unchanged save output without database writes.
release_readiness: REWORK for the local playable scope. The Daily Care defect needs repair and authenticated/mobile acceptance remains incomplete. Local focused passes do not establish clinical or production readiness.
